problems.title: Riemann Hypothesis
problems.subtitle: Riemann Hypothesis
problems.summary: Follow equivalent formulations, reusable tools and missing analytic bridges from ζ / ξ, 5040 and Li.
problems.question: Do all actual nontrivial ζ zeros satisfy Re(rho)=1/2?

nodes.title: Riemann Hypothesis
nodes.summary: Goal: every actual nontrivial ζ zero has real part 1/2. This map provides no verification receipt for RH.

nodes.title: Zeta / ξ: canonical entire function
nodes.summary: Reuse xiReading, entire analyticity and the functional equation. Source is located in a dev snapshot; the axiom closure has not been rechecked here.

nodes.title: Actual zeros / multiplicity / reflection
nodes.summary: Canonical zetaZeroData enumerates the actual nontrivial zeros and preserves analytic multiplicities and symmetries.

nodes.title: Li coefficients: derivative definition
nodes.summary: Actual ξ derivatives, Taylor coefficient identities at every order and local expansions. A local expansion is not a full-disk expansion.

nodes.title: Toeplitz / second differences
nodes.summary: Finite Gram constructions and recursive reconstruction have sources; the equivalence wrapper still takes Li, Fourier and Herglotz analytic hypotheses.

nodes.title: Complete Weil explicit formula
nodes.summary: The same zero sum, prime terms, pole terms and Archimedean terms; convergence assumptions in the signature must be retained.

nodes.title: Nyman: actual L2 / Gram
nodes.summary: Finite pseudoinverse distance for the original half-line functions; RH requires the distance to tend to zero over all stages.

nodes.title: Newton-Hankel real-root criterion
nodes.summary: Real-rootedness and positive semidefiniteness for finite conjugation-stable root families; reuse negative directions obtained by interpolation.

nodes.title: Sigma(n) / Robin ratio
nodes.summary: Actual divisor sum, normalized ratio and prime-exponent padding; not the universal Robin bound.

nodes.title: 5040 threshold / 10080 checker
nodes.summary: The Robin threshold is n>5040. The linked source provides a rational checker and a 10080 instance; finite instances do not establish the universal statement.

nodes.title: Li: full-disk analyticity
nodes.summary: Candidate scripts for both directions of the canonical Li disk equivalence in PR #6219. No verifiable compilation receipt is attached here.

nodes.title: Curvature to probability semigroup
nodes.summary: PR #6114 constructs a semigroup given normalized positive curvature and a recurrence; the actual arithmetic input still needs to be connected.

nodes.title: Actual Weil / prolate model
nodes.summary: Support-sensitive residuals and scale analysis in PR #5602; a fixed window cannot replace unbounded scales.

nodes.title: Derivative Li = complete zero sum
nodes.summary: Complete the identity between the derivative definition and the canonical zero sum, summability and every interchange of operations.

nodes.title: All windows / form domain / spectrum
nodes.summary: Complete the actual operator, form core, full tail control and correspondence at every scale.

nodes.title: Actual ξ to full Jensen tower
nodes.summary: Construct the positive even-order coefficients, entire-function limit and analytic bridges for all degrees and shifts.

nodes.title: Mellin to actual density
nodes.summary: Complete Nyman-Beurling and its integer strengthening; an abstract closure equivalence does not remove this analytic obligation.

nodes.title: From finite checks to all integers
nodes.summary: The Robin inequality for every n≥5041 and both directions of its equivalence with standard RH require actual analytic proofs.

nodes.title: Zero geometry / Mobius
nodes.summary: Preserve the canonical correspondence between actual ξ, nontrivial zeros and reflection.

nodes.title: Li / analytic radius
nodes.summary: Connect the canonical zero sum, disk analysis and all equivalence endpoints.

nodes.title: Circle probability / negative type
nodes.summary: Connect general Herglotz/Schoenberg constructions to actual arithmetic curvature.

nodes.title: Weil / all-window spectrum
nodes.summary: Keep the original complete form and prove identities at every scale, for the core and for the spectrum.

nodes.title: Jensen / real-root tower
nodes.summary: Finite matrix tools have sources; the entire-function bridge for actual ξ remains to be completed.

nodes.title: Nyman / Hardy approximation
nodes.summary: Complete density on the original spaces and the integer-dilation strengthening.

nodes.title: Mobius / prime errors
nodes.summary: Complete Perron, partial summation, prime-power remainders and all-epsilon bounds.

nodes.title: Robin / 5040 / integer extrema
nodes.summary: Track finite certificates, universal integer inequalities and equivalence theorems separately.

nodes.title: Riesz / smoothed sequences
nodes.summary: Construct the original series and all tails, parameters and transport from integers to real variables.

nodes.title: Speiser derivative zeros
nodes.summary: The open-strip zero criterion for the actual ζ derivative, retaining boundary conditions.

nodes.title: BSY logarithmic integral
nodes.summary: Prove treatment of logarithmic singularities, complete tail integrals and the actual zero-sum identity.

nodes.title: Farey discrepancy
nodes.summary: Fix the denominator bound, ordering, norm and asymptotic quantifiers.

nodes.title: Redheffer determinant
nodes.summary: The actual divisibility matrix identity det=M(N) and complete Mobius asymptotics.

nodes.title: de Bruijn–Newman
nodes.summary: Actual heat deformation, existence of the threshold and the unconditional nonnegative lower bound.

nodes.title: Total positivity / PF infinity
nodes.summary: All minors with two independently chosen index sets; principal-minor positive semidefiniteness is insufficient.

nodes.title: Real-line zeta probability
nodes.summary: Distinguish the actual screw function and real-line Levy measure from the circle model.

nodes.title: Suzuki model spaces
nodes.summary: Use the originally specified function family and its L2 norm identity.

nodes.title: Volchkov integral
nodes.summary: The complete iterated integral and treatment of singularities; finite truncations are insufficient.

nodes.title: Bagchi self-approximation
nodes.summary: All compact sets, tolerances, density conditions and countable-exception quantifiers.

nodes.title: Salem integral equation
nodes.summary: The original kernel's Mellin identity and uniqueness for arbitrary bounded functions.

nodes.title: Landau maximal permutation order
nodes.summary: The maximal finite-group order, prime-power optimization identity and all refined thresholds.
